name: Team PRs
description: Your team's open pull requests in a repo: how many, and each one's labels, CI and review.

project.label: Laki project
project.hint: the repo's, by name: for Review in Laki

prompt.label: Review prompt
prompt.default: Review this pull request: read the diff, run what you can, and list what you would change and why.

command.label: Review command
command.hint: a shell command instead, with $PR (its URL), $PR_NUMBER, $LAKI_CLI; empty: a Laki workspace on the PR with the prompt

actions.review: PR="$WIDGET_ARG"; export PR PR_NUMBER="${PR##*/}"; [ -z "$WIDGET_COMMAND" ] || exec sh -c "$WIDGET_COMMAND"; [ -n "$WIDGET_PROJECT" ] || { echo 'Set Laki project (or a Review command) in Settings › Widgets' >&2; exit 1; }; exec "$LAKI_CLI" new "$WIDGET_PROJECT" --pr "$PR" --prompt "$WIDGET_PROMPT"
